title: Create Thread
description: Create and run a basic thread
explanation: std::thread creates a new thread of execution. join() waits for it, detach() lets it run independently.

title: Mutex Lock And Unlock
description: Protect shared data with a mutex
explanation: mutex.lock() and unlock() protect shared data. Prefer lock_guard for exception safety.

title: Lock Guard
description: RAII mutex wrapper for exception-safe locking
explanation: lock_guard locks the mutex on construction and unlocks on destruction, guaranteeing exception safety.

title: Unique Lock
explanation: unique_lock provides more flexibility than lock_guard: deferred locking, manual unlock, and move semantics.

title: Scoped Lock C++17
explanation: scoped_lock locks multiple mutexes using a deadlock-avoidance algorithm.

title: Async And Future
description: Run a task asynchronously and get the result
explanation: std::async runs a function asynchronously and returns a std::future to retrieve the result.

title: Promise And Future
description: Manual promise/future pair for thread communication
explanation: promise/future provide a channel for one-off communication between threads.

title: Atomic Operations
explanation: std::atomic provides lock-free synchronization for primitive types.

title: Condition Variable
explanation: condition_variable allows threads to wait for a condition and be notified when it changes.

title: Thread Local Storage
explanation: thread_local gives each thread its own instance of a variable, eliminating data races.
